name: paperless
compose:
services:
  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:2.14.7
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "8010:8000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - ./media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ./consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
    environment:
      TZ: Etc/UTC
      USERMAP_UID: 1000
      USERMAP_GID: 1000
      PAPERLESS_REDIS: redis://redis:6379
      PAPERLESS_DBHOST: db
      PAPERLESS_DBPASS: 9f3kQ7vT2mXw8LpZ
      PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY: c4Rt8sWq1zYx6NbV3mJk9hGf2dLp7Qe5
  db:
    image: postgres:16.6
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    environment:
      TZ: Etc/UTC
      POSTGRES_DB: paperless
      POSTGRES_USER: paperless
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: 9f3kQ7vT2mXw8LpZ
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U paperless"]
      interval: 10s
      retries: 5
  redis:
    image: redis:7.4.2
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./redis:/data
    environment:
      TZ: Etc/UTC
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      retries: 5
notes: Change PAPERLESS_DBPASS, POSTGRES_PASSWORD and PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY before the first start.
Create the first user with: docker compose run --rm paperless createsuperuser
